findings.title: Residual-offer task permits a fallback that cannot discover unsampled results
findings.description: T13 says to use a discovery surface if one exists, but otherwise restrict selection to store-recorded samples. Those records identify results that have **already** been sampled, so that fallback cannot meet the design’s requirement to offer unsampled results and keep agreement data accumulating. The current metrology code has target-specific review lookup, but no general unsampled-result discovery surface. Add an actionable discovery task rather than permitting the incomplete fallback.

findings.title: Direction precedence contradicts the required low-evidence warning
findings.description: T7 calls its numbered list a precedence order, but places the below-floor return before `TIGHTEN`; following it makes the required below-floor `TIGHTEN` result unreachable. Replace the contradictory sequence with explicit precedence that permits tightening on thin evidence while preventing graduation below the floor or without a version key.

findings.title: Recommendation note omits the runtime-selected model limitation
findings.description: T9 requires the model-pairing note but does not require it to state that a threshold cannot track a model drawn at runtime and that the recommendation does not apply to that step. The design requires this warning in recommendation output. Add it to the implementation and test criteria.

findings.title: Required failure signals are not assigned implementation and test coverage
findings.description: The design requires a malformed `judge:` block to be flagged with a warning and tested, but T8 only tests registered and unregistered templates; the coverage check incorrectly claims the malformed case is exercised. Likewise, T15 requires an explanatory empty-offers line only for a lapse, not for the exhausted “nothing due” case required by the design. Add those behaviors and corresponding tests.

findings.title: Commit markers precede tests and appear after every task
findings.description: This pattern repeats throughout the file: an implementation commit is marked before its immediately following test task, and another marker follows the test. Consolidate markers after coherent implementation-and-test pairs, at working, tested points, rather than after every task.
